newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire envoy in fatal road accident.
newsitem.headline: Zaire envoy in fatal road accident.

text.p: A French teenager was killed and another youngster was seriously injured after they were hit by a car driven by Zaire's ambassador to France on Saturday, police said on Sunday.
Police said ambassador Ramazani Baya was driving a hired car along the seafront boulevard in Menton on the French Riviera when it hit the boys aged 12 and 13.
Police said Baya's car had apparently swerved off the road before hitting the victims. The 12-year-old was in a coma in Nice hospital.
Baya had travelled to Menton to visit Zaire President Mobutu Sese Seko, who is convalescing in Roquebrune Cap Martin on the Riviera after cancer surgery in August.
Police said the ambassador had submitted to a breathalyser test which had proved negative.
